verdicts.reason: A scatters the badges: ONLINE ONLY sits at the left, LIMITED RUN floats alone at the right and NEW hangs beside a right-shifted CTA that breaks the centred headline axis. The SOLSTICE logo is barely visible, the product is tiny and 'Swipe up to shop' is jammed under the body copy. B keeps the headline, body and CTA on one centred axis, but it is still cramped: the CTA nearly touches the bottom edge, 'Swipe up' is wedged between the body and the button, the logo is a faint speck at the top right, and the NEW/LIMITED RUN pills crowd the top-left corner, cut off from the product.
